items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: You know they sent for René. And René didn't want to go... René used to teach shawky

ctx.x: Well anyway, who did you hear in Chicago when you were out there? Did you hear any music? Yeah.

I used to be out there, 28 in the league, out there, and Louis and them would be out there. Louis was living on, he was playing at the, you see, when Louis come up there, they sent for Lee Collins. You know they sent for René. And René didn't want to go, and Louis went. He was playing at the Royal Garden with Joe Oliver. You understand? You went there? No, I was a little bit too young. You understand what I mean? Well I was in Chicago when they come up there, you see. And I was living on East 36th Street with my…
You were taking music lessons while you were out there too?
